title: Bit more nether
description: Do you wish for a bit (and just a bit) more of nether? Well here it is, a mod that adds a little dungeon and a bit more mobs to the nether, including a Ghost that has the chance to drop Netherite scrap, to a little fire, and so more on!
body:
This mod gives the Nether a small but meaningful expansion. If you feel the Nether is missing just a little more mystery, danger, and reward, this project is designed for you.

# What it adds:

A mini dungeon that generates deep in the Nether, adding exploration and challenge without overwhelming your world, including a spawner with a new mob.

## Several new mobs, including:

Nether Wraith – a rare, spectral enemy with a chance to drop Netherite Scraps.

Lava Hound – a creature that roams the Nether, inmune to fire .

Additional atmosphere and variety to the Nether, while keeping the vanilla feel intact.

## New Sword and items:

Including a Ghast Eye, that can be encounter in the new dungeon, and a Ghast Sword, made out of the Ghast Eye.

Piglin Brutes drop a Netherite Heart! with a 10% chance of dropping it, if you keep it in your inventory, you get 2 more base hearts.

![New "Bastion Dungeon"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60adf2537a087a817752739bc6336490d0226879.png)
                                               
The main goal is so the Nether feels fresher without being overcrowded with features.

Adds more reasons to explore the Nether and return there after your first visit.

Provides new loot opportunities through the Ghost’s rare drops.

Perfect for players who want more adventure but still value Minecraft’s original style.

### Other important information:

This mod is designed to be simple and easy to add to your game, with minimal performance impact.

It does not overhaul or replace major Nether features, making it highly compatible with most other mods.

Currently focused on dungeons and mobs, keeping the scope small and polished.
